tools.name: get_conditions
tools.description: Current swimming and family scores (0 to 10) with water temperature, wave height and wind for Mallorca beaches, from the hourly forecast and official AEMET warnings. Optionally filter to one beach or one region. Each answer states when it was generated and until when it is valid.

tools.name: best_beaches_now
tools.description: The Mallorca beaches ranked by conditions score, with provisional seasonal crowd estimates shown separately. Only beaches with a valid current forecast are included.

tools.name: list_beaches
tools.description: All beaches covered by the site, with slug, name, municipality and region. Use a slug with get_beach_guide or get_conditions.

tools.name: get_beach_guide
tools.description: The reviewed guide for one beach in Markdown: overview, access and parking, sand and water, facilities, crowds, wind, hazards and the official sources used.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "best_beaches_now" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The Mallorca beaches with the highest current score for swimming or for a family visit, best first. Only beaches with a valid current forecast are included." → after: "The Mallorca beaches ranked by conditions score, with provisional seasonal crowd estimates shown separately. Only beaches with a valid current forecast are included."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
